Create a production game sprite sheet for Color Resonance. Reference 1 is the exact established character Chrome, a young HUMAN man with short opaque charcoal hair, grey eyes, black travelling coat with restrained blue lining, trousers and boots. Keep face, hair, outfit consistent. Reference 2 is Renoir, the small living night-coloured spirit containing four soft coloured lights; he voluntarily becomes a purification sword for Chrome in the postgame. Make a TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no checkerboard drawn, no scene, no labels. A regular 2 columns x 2 rows grid, four equal cells, exactly ONE full body Chrome per cell, identical scale, feet fixed at 91% of each cell, same facing three-quarter left, ample padding. Cell reading order: 0 quiet ready stance holding sword lowered; 1 walking left with alternate leg lifted and coat moving slightly; 2 clearly attacking with forward sword slash, body leaning; 3 calmly extending the sword to purify, left hand open and a small smooth rainbow halo at blade. The sword has a deep midnight handle shaped as a simple Renoir rounded spirit and a transparent clear blade edged with four softly coloured lights; keep black as beautiful night, not evil. No huge effects obscuring silhouette. Clean painterly anime fantasy game art matching reference, readable small sprites, smooth surfaces, no text.
